label: Hospital outpatient department
note: Hospital-based setting; facility fees are usually billed on top of the doctor's fee.

label: Doctor's office
note: Office rates for doctors usually include practice costs, so they run higher than the same doctor's fee in a facility.

label: Federally qualified health center
note: Community health center rates are usually one all-inclusive payment per visit, so they aren't comparable to other settings.

label: Rural health clinic
note: Rural health clinic rates are usually one all-inclusive payment per visit, so they aren't comparable to other settings.

label: Telehealth, patient at home
note: Plans can pay telehealth differently depending on where the patient is, so the two are compared separately.

label: Telehealth, patient not at home
note: Plans can pay telehealth differently depending on where the patient is, so the two are compared separately.

label: Any setting
note: The plan says the rate applies wherever the service is provided.

label: Setting not stated
note: The file doesn't say where this rate applies.
